description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the BeanJsonSerializer utility class in SuiteCRM, testing serialization and conversion to array for contact and account beans.

classes.name: BeanJsonSerializerTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the BeanJsonSerializer utility, testing serialization and array conversion of BeanMock instances.

methods.name: testToArrayContact
methods.description: Tests the conversion of a ContactBean JSON to an array and compares it with an expected array.

methods.name: testToArrayAccount
methods.description: Tests the conversion of an AccountBean JSON to an array and compares it with an expected array.

methods.name: testSerializeContact
methods.description: Tests the serialization of a ContactBean JSON into a JSON string and compares with expected JSON file.

methods.name: testSerializeAccount
methods.description: Tests the serialization of an AccountBean JSON into a JSON string and compares with expected JSON file.
